mapper.select: SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.status_code AS status_code, asm.name AS assignment_status_name, asm.description AS assignment_status_description, CASE WHEN km.type_code = 102 AND ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(ka.mid_self_score, child_self.avg_child_self_score) ELSE ka.mid_self_score END AS mid_self_score, CASE WHEN km.type_code = 102 AND ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(ka.end_self_score, child_self.avg_child_self_score) ELSE ka.end_self_score END AS end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score, ka.end_gm_score, ka.evidences::text AS evidences, ki.target_description, ki.weight, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, km.calculation_rule_code AS calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code AS calculation_type_code, kc.name AS category_name, sc_type.name AS kpi_type_name, u.id AS user_id, COALESCE(kas.user_full_name, u.full_name) AS user_full_name, u.username AS user_username, r.code AS rank_code, COALESCE(kas.supervisor_id, ud.supervisor_id) AS assignee_supervisor_id, COALESCE(kas.supervisor_full_name, sup.full_name) AS assignee_supervisor_full_name, COALESCE(kas.department_id, d.id) AS section_id, COALESCE(kas.department_name, d.name) AS section_name, COALESCE(kas_dept.manager_id, d.manager_id) AS section_manager_id, mgr.full_name AS section_manager_full_name, ( SELECT r2.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r2 ON r2.id = ur.role_id AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r2.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r2.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_code, ( SELECT r2.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r2 ON r2.id = ur.role_id AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r2.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r2.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_name, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(uks.evaluation_comments, '')), '') AS evaluation_comments, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(uks.evaluation_comments_promotion, '')), '') AS evaluation_comments_promotion, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(uks.evaluation_supervisor_comments, '')), '') AS supervisor_comment_portfolio, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(uks.evaluation_supervisor_comments_promotion, '')), '') AS supervisor_comment_promotion FROM users u INNER JOIN kpi_cycles cyc ON cyc.id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND cyc.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE INNER JOIN departments d ON ud.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ka.kpi_info_id) ka.* FROM kpi_assignments ka WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.user_id = u.id AND ka.status_code IN (401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 406, 407, 501, 502, 503, 601, 602, 603) ORDER BY ka.kpi_info_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ka.end_self_score, ka.mid_self_score) IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN ka.parent_assignment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ka.status_code DESC, ka.updated_at DESC, ka.created_at DESC ) ka ON TRUE LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_snapshots kas ON kas.assignment_id = ka.id AND kas.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id AND cyc.year < EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int LEFT JOIN departments kas_dept ON kas_dept.id = kas.department_id AND kas_dept.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT AVG(COALESCE(ch.end_self_score, ch.mid_self_score)) AS avg_child_self_score FROM kpi_assignments ch WHERE ch.parent_assignment_id = ka.id AND ch.cycle_id = ka.cycle_id AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(ch.end_self_score, ch.mid_self_score) IS NOT NULL ) child_self ON TRUE LEFT JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes sc_type ON sc_type.code = km.type_code AND sc_type.category = 'KPI_TYPE' LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes asm ON asm.code = ka.status_code AND asm.category = 'ASM_STATUS' LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON jt.id = COALESCE(kas.job_title_id, u.job_title_id) AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ranks r ON jt.rank_id = r.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_kpi_summaries uks ON uks.user_id = u.id AND uks.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND uks.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users mgr ON mgr.id = COALESCE(kas_dept.manager_id, d.manager_id) AND mgr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users sup ON sup.id = COALESCE(kas.supervisor_id, ud.supervisor_id) AND sup.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(u.is_active, TRUE) = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur_member INNER JOIN roles role_member ON role_member.id = ur_member.role_id AND role_member.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur_member.user_id = u.id AND UPPER(role_member.code) IN ('PM', 'LEADER', 'MEMBER') ) ORDER BY COALESCE(kas.department_name, d.name), COALESCE(kas.user_full_name, u.full_name), kc.name, km.code
